modelObjects.name: CORVEN
modelObjects.caption: Autonomous systems security
modelObjects.description: Architecture of CORVEN, dependency-aware incident response for autonomous AI agent networks.

modelObjects.name: Security Operator
modelObjects.caption: Investigates and approves
modelObjects.description: Security engineer or infrastructure operator who investigates incidents and approves sensitive containment.

modelObjects.name: Agent Owner
modelObjects.caption: Registers agents
modelObjects.description: Platform developer or owner who registers agents, permissions, resources and workflows.

modelObjects.name: Auditor
modelObjects.caption: Verifies evidence
modelObjects.description: Independently checks incident records and response history.

modelObjects.name: CORVEN
modelObjects.caption: Incident response layer
modelObjects.description: Maps agent dependencies, calculates blast radius, plans and enforces minimum safe containment, verifies the result and records evidence.

modelObjects.name: Monitored AI Agents
modelObjects.caption: Agents under protection
modelObjects.description: Autonomous agents and their workflows whose operations pass through CORVEN enforcement points.

modelObjects.name: Protected Resources
modelObjects.caption: APIs, data, credentials
modelObjects.description: Wallets, APIs, databases and credentials agents depend on. CORVEN can only enforce on those routed through its gateway.

modelObjects.name: Incident Signal Source
modelObjects.caption: External detection
modelObjects.description: Source of external compromise signals. Not yet defined in the PRD.

modelObjects.name: ENS
modelObjects.caption: Agent identity names
modelObjects.description: Provides ENS names used as agent identity references.

modelObjects.name: Ethereum Sepolia
modelObjects.caption: Testnet blockchain
modelObjects.description: Hosts CORVEN contracts and provides transaction references.

modelObjects.name: Arkiv
modelObjects.caption: Decentralized records
modelObjects.description: Stores incident snapshots, plans and outcomes for later retrieval.

modelObjects.name: Chainlink CRE
modelObjects.caption: Workflow runtime
modelObjects.description: Runs the incident workflow that validates signals and triggers on-chain response.

modelObjects.name: Web Dashboard
modelObjects.caption: Operator UI
modelObjects.description: Dependency graph, incident detail, containment approval and evidence viewer.

modelObjects.name: Backend API
modelObjects.caption: Modular monolith
modelObjects.description: Fastify service hosting all domain modules and integration adapters. Single deployable unit.

modelObjects.name: PostgreSQL
modelObjects.caption: Operational source of truth
modelObjects.description: Agents, dependencies, incidents, plans, approvals, execution records and evidence.

modelObjects.name: CORVEN Contracts
modelObjects.caption: On-chain permission state
modelObjects.description: Solidity contracts on Sepolia holding revocable authorization and emitting response events.

modelObjects.name: Agent Registry
modelObjects.caption: Agents and status
modelObjects.description: Registers agents, identity references and status changes.

modelObjects.name: Dependency Registry
modelObjects.caption: Typed relationships
modelObjects.description: Stores authority, resource and operational dependencies.

modelObjects.name: Graph Engine
modelObjects.caption: Deterministic graph
modelObjects.description: Builds the typed graph and answers traversal, path and shared-dependency queries.

modelObjects.name: Incident Management
modelObjects.caption: Incident lifecycle
modelObjects.description: Owns incident state machine and orchestrates the response.

modelObjects.name: Blast-Radius Engine
modelObjects.caption: Impact analysis
modelObjects.description: Computes affected agents, resources and workflows with explaining paths.

modelObjects.name: Containment Engine
modelObjects.caption: Minimum safe plan
modelObjects.description: Deterministically computes the smallest safe set of authorization changes.

modelObjects.name: Authorization Gateway
modelObjects.caption: Enforcement boundary
modelObjects.description: Checks and enforces authorization on operations and rechecks in-flight ones.

modelObjects.name: Approval Service
modelObjects.caption: Human approval
modelObjects.description: Presents plans and records approvals or rejections from authorized users.

modelObjects.name: Verification Service
modelObjects.caption: Post-containment checks
modelObjects.description: Retries the blocked operation and tests a healthy workflow.

modelObjects.name: Evidence Service
modelObjects.caption: Hash-linked records
modelObjects.description: Hashes, signs and links incident records and retrieves them for verification.

modelObjects.name: Ethereum Adapter
modelObjects.caption: Chain access
modelObjects.description: Submits transactions and reads contract state.

modelObjects.name: ENS Adapter
modelObjects.caption: Identity resolution
modelObjects.description: Resolves and validates ENS names.

modelObjects.name: Arkiv Adapter
modelObjects.caption: Record storage
modelObjects.description: Writes and reads Arkiv records.

modelObjects.name: CRE Adapter
modelObjects.caption: Signal intake
modelObjects.description: Receives and validates workflow results from Chainlink CRE.

modelConnections.name: Requests operations through
modelConnections.description: Operations pass through CORVEN's enforcement boundary.

modelConnections.name: Protects access to
modelConnections.description: Only for resources routed through the gateway.
